articles.title: 74-year-old man charged for child abduction in Caledon: police
articles.summary: A 74-year-old man has been charged after an attempted abduction of a child last Saturday evening in Caledon, Ontario Provincial Police say.

articles.title: Pickering teen hospitalized with life-altering injuries after e-scooter crash
articles.summary: A 16-year-old boy is in hospital with life-altering injuries after his electric scooter collided with a vehicle in Pickering Tuesday night.

articles.title: Carney's 'hydronym' moment is behind a cheeky campaign to raise awareness about Lake Ontario
articles.summary: Riding on Prime Minister Mark Carney's use of the proper word for a body of water, a London, Ont., company has created T-shirts emblazoned with "My hydronyms are Lake and Ontario." A portion of the apparel sales proceeds go to Swim Drink Fish Canada, a charity that connects people with the lake, and works to keep it safe and clean.
